query: Consider the following context: Materials capable of withstanding extreme environments open promising opportunities for nuclear fusion reactors. In that context, which material can be used for interlayer materials between W and CuCrZr, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Using a Ni-based interlayer between tungsten (W) and CuCrZr will mitigate thermal expansion mismatches under fusion-relevant temperatures, increasing the mechanical reliability of the joint compared to direct W–CuCrZr bonding.
generation.material_initial_state: W and CuCrZr plates configured for joining with no intermediate layer.
generation.intervention: Introduce a Ni-based interlayer during diffusion bonding or vacuum brazing of W to CuCrZr.
generation.conditions: High temperature environment typical of nuclear fusion reactor operating conditions.
generation.structural_mediator: A Ni-based layer between the W and CuCrZr interfaces.
generation.mechanism: Reduced thermal expansion mismatch stress and improved metallurgical bonding, leading to lower stress concentration and better load transfer across the interface.
generation.predicted_outcome: Enhanced interfacial strength and reduced cracking or delamination in W–CuCrZr assemblies at elevated temperatures.
generation.baseline: Direct W–CuCrZr bonding without an interlayer, prone to high stress and risk of separation in extreme thermal conditions.
generation.boundary: Performance remains subject to further validation in actual reactor environments and may depend on specific thermal cycles.
generation.uncertainty: Precise magnitudes of improved mechanical properties or service lifetimes are yet to be determined experimentally.

falsification_experiment.design: Join W and CuCrZr samples with and without a Ni-based interlayer using identical diffusion bonding or brazing parameters, then subject them to repeated thermal cycles at fusion-relevant conditions and measure joint failure.
measurements: Tensile/shear strength of bonded joints at elevated temperatures
Microscopic evaluation of cracks or delamination in the interlayer region
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the Ni-based interlayer does not exhibit lower stress and reduced cracking or delamination under the same conditions compared to the baseline, the hypothesis is invalidated.
